prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A strict asset contact sheet with exactly three columns and exactly two rows on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly six TOTAL separate single handmade objects, one centered in each equal invisible cell with generous empty charcoal margin. Top row left to right: ONLY one teal felt circle patch; ONLY one plum-purple felt petal; ONLY one coral felt spiral coil. Bottom row left to right: ONLY one marigold grosgrain ribbon bow; ONLY one cream lace loop with a clear open center; ONLY one fluffy pink wool pom-pom. Top-down camera, tactile fibers, irregular handmade edges, contained soft shadow. Every cell contains only its named object directly on charcoal. Absolutely no backing squares, no backing circles, no stacked layers, no extra colors behind an object, no piles, duplicates, borders, labels, text, letters, or hands.
